headline: As of 2026-10-12: 3,348,127 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 34 of 50 states, D+24.4 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 3,348,127 early/mail ballots cast so far across 34 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+24.4 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Florida (526,625), Virginia (519,970), Michigan (393,689).
